newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Investor CEO Dahlback to S-E-Banken board.
newsitem.headline: Investor CEO Dahlback to S-E-Banken board.

text.p: The chief executive of Swedish investment company Investor AB, Claes Dahlback, has been proposed to become a member of banking group S-E-Banken's board, the bank said on Friday.

Jacob Wallenberg, the son of Wallenberg family head Peter Wallenberg, has also been proposed as a new board member. The bank has previously announced Jacob Wallenberg will take over as chief executive from Bjorn Svedberg.

The moves follow a Thursday announcement that Peter Wallenberg will step down from his chairman's post at Investor, the Wallenberg family's investment vehicle, to be replaced by Percy Barnevik, one of Sweden's top business leaders.
Business daily Dagens Industri said on Friday that the aim was for Dahlback to be elected chairman of S-E-Banken at the 1998 annual general meeting.
Dahlback would then presumably be forced to leave Investor as Swedish corporate law prohibits the head of an investment company from also being chairman of a bank, the newspaper said.
Marcus Wallenberg, currently vice president of Investor and a nephew of board chairman Peter Wallenberg, could at that point become chief executive of Investor, the Dagens Industri said.
"The analysis is correct," Peter Wallenberg, the powerful family's head, was quoted as saying.
